notes:
Original and replication statistics are separately printed author-derived r values from the primary authors’ Table S1; no metric conversion performed here. Table S2 p. 20 identifies the target contrasts. Supplied replication page locator (p. 3 or p. 5) does not contain the target statistics in this supplement. No authors’ narrative verdict located; the Table S1 categorical Replicated entry is Yes. Original full text obtained as IZA DP4030 (February 2009), matching title/authors but predating the final article. Its Table 3 prints efficiency 0.16 for B/V and 0.81 for B/LV, and only p<0.05. Final-test r and p above are explicitly attributed to the replication authors’ Table S1; the working-paper statistics were not merged into those values. Analytic matching-group n not explicitly printed as a total.
